# Seed stability (generated by `python3 -m experiments.run_stability`)

15 instances × 5 seeds per setting. *Pairwise cosine*: mean cosine similarity between the attribution vectors of different seeds (1 = identical direction). *Relative spread*: mean distance of an attribution to the across-seed mean, divided by the norm of that mean. *Prediction SD*: across-seed standard deviation of the surrogate's prediction at 50 fixed points 1 std away.

| Setting | Method | Pairwise cosine | Relative spread | Prediction SD |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1-D bumps | LIME | 0.9200 | 0.0829 | 0.008354 |
| 1-D bumps | ArcTanh-LIME | 1.0000 | 0.0423 | 0.003639 |
| Two moons - MLP (2-D) | LIME | 0.9985 | 0.0538 | 0.01192 |
| Two moons - MLP (2-D) | ArcTanh-LIME | 0.9311 | 0.0616 | 0.01322 |
| Synthetic 8-D - MLP | LIME | 0.9896 | 0.0867 | 0.009243 |
| Synthetic 8-D - MLP | ArcTanh-LIME | 0.9921 | 0.0809 | 0.01201 |
| Synthetic 8-D - random forest | LIME | 0.9932 | 0.0751 | 0.005598 |
| Synthetic 8-D - random forest | ArcTanh-LIME | 0.5898 | 0.3410 | 0.002217 |
| Friedman #1 - MLP | LIME | 0.9943 | 0.0674 | 0.1045 |
| Friedman #1 - MLP | ArcTanh-LIME | 0.9958 | 0.0573 | 0.1067 |
